title: The Predictability Bias of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2610.13237v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn by predicting teacher representations of masked regions from visible context. Point prediction summarizes the conditional target distribution and cannot reproduce variation that the context does not resolve. We call this constraint predictability bias. In computed tomography (CT), recurrent anatomy is predictable from context, whereas the sporadic, localized pathology that determines clinical interpretation often is not. We introduce TAP-JEPA, a ViT-B/3D trained on 113,611 CT volumes that is competitive with state-of-the-art encoders (COLIPRI, Merlin, VoxelFM) in scan-level classification. We then audit the learned predictive pathway by replaying the exact masking, teacher, and predictor computations used during training. Prediction lowers the mean Skill (prevalence-normalized average precision) from 0.388 to 0.271 for pathology, but only from 0.921 to 0.873 for anatomy. Along the

translated_title: 医学影像中联合嵌入预测学习的可预测性偏差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13237v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过从可见上下文预测被掩码区域的教师表示来进行学习。点预测是对条件目标分布的总结，无法再现上下文未能解析的变异性。我们将这一约束称为“可预测性偏差”。在计算机断层扫描（CT）中，重复出现的解剖结构可以从上下文中预测出来，而决定临床解读的散发性、局灶性病理往往无法预测。我们提出了TAP-JEPA，这是一个在113,611个CT体积数据上训练的ViT-B/3D模型，在扫描级分类任务上与最先进的编码器（COLIPRI、Merlin、VoxelFM）具有竞争力。随后，我们通过重放训练期间所使用的精确掩码、教师和预测器计算来审计所学到的预测路径。预测将病理的平均Skill分数（患病率归一化的平均精度）从0.388降低至0.271，而解剖结构的Skill分数仅从0.921降至0.873。沿着（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TAP-JEPA模型并首次揭示了联合嵌入预测学习中的“可预测性偏差”——预测路径对可从上下文推断的解剖结构预测能力保持良好，但对临床诊断至关重要的散发性局灶病理的预测能力显著下降。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TAP-JEPA and reveals a "predictability bias" in joint-embedding predictive learning: the learned predictive pathway preserves performance on context-predictable anatomy but substantially degrades for the sporadic, localized pathology that drives clinical interpretation.
